parameters.name: FromEcs
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the request is redirected from the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) console. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas get-can-try-sas --from-ecs true --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas GetCanTrySas --region cn-hangzhou --FromEcs true --Lang zh
